body: The full release Docker run repeatedly left newly arrived books pending after cleanup and ignored-format cases. The bind mount exposed fresh directory entries while directory stat retained old mtime and size, so the polling optimization never refreshed file state. A bounded monotonic full reconciliation now detects nested arrivals and replacements while preserving fired-event markers. Two real-loop file regressions failed before the fix and pass after it; final ordered container verification is recorded with PR #2208.

resolution.note: Periodic full reconciliation bounds stale-directory metadata blindness to 30 monotonic seconds. Two real-loop nested-arrival and replacement scenarios seen red then green; all 16 polling watcher tests pass. Independent review found no introduced regression. Combined runtime release gate is tracked in PR #2208.

title: Cached directory metadata can indefinitely starve polling ingest
